questions.question: Walk me through how you would profile a new customer source feed and document its metadata, grain, keys, null patterns, and target mappings before building an automated ETL job.

In your Honeywell work, you migrated SQL Server data to Snowflake using Python and SnowSQL. How did you reconcile source and target data, handle failures or reruns, and demonstrate that the migration was complete?

Describe the approach behind the Redshift query improvements you reported as up to 100x faster for Tableau and SAS Visual Analytics. What did you diagnose, what changes did you make, and how did you validate the improvement?

Suppose an existing application must consume a modified customer data feed, but a key field has changed format and historical values are inconsistent. How would you assess the impact, update mappings and ETL logic, and communicate the release risk?
What data-quality rules have you implemented or operated for ingestion pipelines, and how did you manage exceptions, reconciliation, and escalation when a rule failed?

This role requires controlled use of master-data configurations. What experience do you have with master-data concepts such as canonical identifiers, reference data, survivorship, or change control, and how would you get up to speed where your direct experience is limited?

Tell me about a time you gathered requirements with business stakeholders—for example, during your Joint Application Development sessions at IHS Markit—and translated them into T-SQL procedures, mappings, reports, or ETL requirements. How did you resolve ambiguity?

Describe a production or post-deployment issue involving an Airflow DAG, Snowflake load, Redshift process, or SQL Server/SSIS package. How did you investigate it, restore service, and prevent recurrence?

Your background includes data lake feeds in JSON, CSV, XML, and DAT formats. How would you apply that experience to learn and ingest aviation data frames such as DFDR, QAR, ARINC-717, or ARINC-429, which are new to you?
What attracts you to this data-engineering role, and how would you contribute in an agile team through clear status communication, support for teammates, and experimentation with improved automation?
